title: Angkor Wat
axis: +X east across the west-facing temple axis; +Z south; +Yup.
source: Exact original OSM area payload establishes three gallery multipolygons/courtyard holes, fifty explicit-height roof/tower parts and five tower footprint controls, six library footprints, cruciform galleries/Terrace of Honor, four outer gateways, four enclosure wall polylines and the ancient west causeway polygon. Original coordinates retained in source/map controls; native heights and note="simplified shape" are mapped estimates, not survey accuracy. Roof sections, stone steps/courses/colonnade and baluster/window repeats, lost gate fragments and concealed details are photographic medium-fi interpretations. Far LODs simplify small plan articulations while retaining all defining structures.

geometryLabel: Native ancient architectural perimeters/courtyard holes and enclosure wall lines; central first-gallery outline is distinct from the full outer enclosure

terrainContact.basis: Fixed west bank approach3moutside the native ancient causeway before terrain acquisition. Approximate distributed wall/library levels follow preserved raw relief; core terrace floors remain estimated intrinsic architecture.

notes: Complete Angkor Wat ancient architectural ensemble: five central lotus-bud towers and their tiered sanctuaries; three concentric galleries with native open courts, cruciform connecting galleries, six mapped libraries, bounded intrinsic terraces/stone stairs/paved causeways and naga balustrades; west monumental gopura plus north/east/south outer gates and full native enclosure wall network. Include ancient western bridge/causeway footprint. No natural moat/water/forest/landscape mesh or entire82ha ground slab; modern floating pontoon/access facilities, later separate stupa/monasteries/sculpture collections, neighboring Angkor monuments and people excluded.
